audit.whatIsWrong: The chart gave Levels 2, 3 and First item to Kled and Levels 1, 4-5 and 6 to Skill, while every single one of those stages' whys describes Fiora winning ('her W parry blanks your E-dash entry and stuns you out of the trade', 'her vital true-damage out-trades your remount', 'her parry plus vital procs still edge the extended duel').
audit.why: Packet levelChart is Fiora at all six early rows with Kled only at 2+ items, the win rate is 48.28% over 290 games, and the already-audited mirror recorded exactly this: 'win[0..5] and phases[0..5].side -> Fiora; win[6]/phases[6] stay Kled'.
audit.corrected: Levels 1 through First item all flipped to Fiora in both layers with Kled ratings dropped to 4/4/4/3/4/4; 2+ items stays Kled and its rating raised to 6/10.

audit.whatIsWrong: No cooldowns on the tracked ability, which is the whole matchup.
audit.why: Riposte is 24/22/20/18/16s — the longest cooldown in the lane at rank 1, so baiting it buys a genuinely enormous window. Lunge is 13/11.25/9.5/7.75/6s and Grand Challenge 110/90/70s.
audit.corrected: 24s in dosFull[0].d, report[5].t and breakdown.cooldowns; Lunge's 13s in dontsFull[2].d; Grand Challenge's 110s in breakdown.cooldowns.

audit.whatIsWrong: The page said only 'Parries your Q-pull. Bait it.' — it never stated WHY that specific mistake is catastrophic, and it never mentioned that Lunge applies on-hit effects or that Duelist's Dance heals her.
audit.why: Riot's W text: 'This stab slows the first enemy champion hit, or stuns them if Fiora blocked an immobilizing effect with this ability.' Bear Trap on a Rope tethers and yanks, which IS an immobilizing effect — so hooking into an up Riposte does not merely whiff, it hands her a stun on you. The mirror independently confirmed this claim is correct on Fiora's side. Riot's passive: hitting a Vital 'restores Health and gains Move Speed', which is the Grievous Wounds trigger; Riot's Q applies on-hit effects, so her damage scales with what she builds, not just with raw AD.
audit.corrected: dosFull[0].d, dontsFull[0].d, report[5].t and breakdown.cooldowns all state that Bear Trap's yank comes back as a stun; dontsFull[1].d and whys[3] state the Vital heal and move speed; dontsFull[2].d states Lunge's on-hit application and 13s cooldown.
